item.title: Zebra Prachi dies at Mysuru Zoo
item.description: Mysuru: Prachi, a 10-year-old female Zebra, died at Mysuru Zoo yesterday. She was pregnant, suffering from intestinal obstruction caused by enteroliths and was under treatment.
